Class SphereWordTextureMaterial

java.lang.Object
net.murat.material.SphereWordTextureMaterial
All Implemented Interfaces:
Material
public class SphereWordTextureMaterial extends Object implements Material
Sphere material that paints a word and an optional image on a spherical texture.

By default (followObjectRotation = false) the texture is looked up from the world-space normal, so only the shape itself rotates and the texture stays fixed in the scene. When followObjectRotation is true the texture is looked up from the object-space hit position, so the text and the image rotate, scale and translate together with the sphere.

Matrix convention: the matrix received through setObjectTransform(Matrix4) is the inverse (world space to object space) transform, the same convention WordMaterial uses.
